activity.notes: Sō Yoshitoshi was the Sō-clan lord of Tsushima from 1588 until his death in 1615. ATLAS does not model the Sō family itself as a polity; it uses Tsushima as the durable island political unit governed by the clan. His significance includes both participation in Hideyoshi's Korean invasions and the later restoration of Japan–Joseon diplomatic exchange through Tsushima.
